post.caption:
Your circadian clock is not exactly 24 hours, so it has to be reset daily, and the signal that resets it is light. A master clock in the hypothalamus reads that and sets temperature, alertness, hunger and hormone timing by it. Melatonin is not a sedative, it is a darkness signal. Jet lag and shift work are the same argument in different clothes. The practical version: morning daylight is a stronger lever than evening screen avoidance, and consistent timing beats total duration.
